verdict.rationale: React renders components into real browser DOM nodes via createRoot and hydrateRoot (react-docs-8, react-docs-9). React Developer Tools lets developers inspect components, edit props and state, and find performance problems (react-docs-14), so UI debugging in the browser is documented. However, React reaches the DOM through its own reconciliation abstraction (react-comm-5), and no evidence describes debugging the rendered DOM nodes directly in native browser devtools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inspecting React-rendered DOM elements in standard browser devtools, independent or hands-on corroboration of the devtools debugging workflow
